name: Result Popups for CF7
author: Azamat

sections.description:
Contact Form 7 is a staple for WordPress sites—but the default confirmation messages? Not so much.

Result Popups for CF7 replaces those inline alerts with beautiful, customizable SweetAlert modals. It just works out of the box—no settings required—but if you’re a power user, you’ll find plenty to tweak.

Why use Result Popups?
– It looks amazing.
– It improves form UX.
– It makes your site feel more modern.

Use cases:
– Alert users when their form was submitted successfully.
– Show styled error or spam messages in a modal window.
– Replace native CF7 alerts with a modern visual experience.

Features

  • ✅ Works automatically—no configuration needed
  • 🎨 Optional settings panel with popup behavior and style options
  • 💬 Handles all CF7 statuses: success, validation errors, spam, and failures
  • 🌐 Translation-ready and lightweight
  • 🔄 Graceful fallback to native messages if plugin is deactivated
  • ⚙️ Lightweight, flexible, and easy to set up
  • 🔌 Works as a native Contact Form 7 extension — no complex setup required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/result-popups-for-cf7/ or install via the Plugin Directory
  2. Activate via the Plugins screen
  3. Ensure Contact Form 7 is active
  4. Navigate to Contact → Result Popups to customize (optional)
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require configuration?

Nope. Install and activate it. You’ll instantly see SweetAlert popups instead of the default CF7 messages.

Can I customize the popup appearance?

Yes. Go to Contact → Result Popups in your dashboard to adjust color, size, position, and behavior.

Will it affect existing Contact Form 7 behavior?

Not at all. It only replaces the visual output of success/error messages.

Does it support multiple forms on a single page?

Yes. Each form’s message is handled independently.
